thread:
Samira Patel: Hi team — started today in ML Infra. Hitting a blocker: our GH Actions smoke job needs to flip a staging feature flag during setup but I don’t have Console access to toggle flags or a service account for CI. Who handles staging role mappings?
Priya Nair: Welcome Samira! :wave: For staging you can get the `feature_flag_admin` role scoped to the staging org. Prod requires an RFC + manager + security sign-off.
Samira Patel: Thanks. Is there a direct request flow or do I need to file an infra ticket?
onboard-bot: Hi Samira! Please use the internal access request form: https://redwood.internal/access-requests. Choose "Console roles (staging)" and include your manager for approval. Eng-infra processes the approvals and issues service accounts if needed.
Marco Diaz: If you want programmatic flips in GHA, we usually provision a short-lived service account and store the token in HashiCorp Vault. @Samira — which workflow spins the smoke tests? (main branch PRs or scheduled?)
Samira Patel: It's on PRs for model infra changes. The local dev flow uses this curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://console-staging.internal/api/v1/flags/toggle \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"ml-experimental","value":true}'
```
Liz Chen: Two notes: (1) request a service account with `console.flags.write`; (2) we bind that SA to `feature_flag_admin` in the staging org. We'll need least-privilege justification and an expiry window — 30 days is standard for CI tokens.
Samira Patel: What should I write for least-privilege justification? Something like "CI smoke tests require toggling staging flags to validate rollout behavior for model infra PRs"?
Alex T.: That's concise and good. Also specify the exact flag namespace and the PR job name in the form. That speeds approvals.
Priya Nair: PS: if you can rewrite the test to use `ff-test/*` namespace, those flags are auto-scoped for tests and don't require full admin role. Less friction.
Samira Patel: Didn't know about `ff-test/*` — thanks. I can try that while the SA request is being processed.
Marco Diaz: If you still need SA for other tasks, ping me after you submit the form. I create the SA and write the Vault path. We avoid handing raw tokens; use Vault reference in GHA secrets.
Samira Patel: Submitted request: https://redwood.internal/access-requests/req-2026-516. Put the justification and asked for 30d expiry.
Liz Chen: I’ll pre-approve the role binding conditional on infra creating the SA and the Vault path. Marco, can you confirm the policy name you’ll attach to the SA?
Marco Diaz: Will attach `console-ci-flag-flipper` policy with only `console.flags.write` and limited org scope. I'll post the Vault path `secret/data/ci/console/sa-2026-516` and a snippet for GHA usage when ready. ETA 48 hours.
Samira Patel: Amazing, thank you. That timeline works.
DevOps Bot: New secret path created draft at secret/data/ci/console/sa-2026-516 (pending human upload).
Alex T.: Quick FYI — if the PR job runs in forks, we can’t access Vault secrets from forked PRs; may need a gate or run the job only for branch builds. Keep that in mind.
Samira Patel: Good catch. For now we'll gate the flag flip job to run only on branch builds from the repo.
Priya Nair: If you'd like, I can do a 15m Console flags walkthrough after lunch. Covers the admin panel, `ff-test/*` pattern, and best practices.
Samira Patel: Yes please — 1:30pm PT would be perfect.
Marco Diaz: I'll join to walk through the Vault bits too.
Samira Patel: Thanks all! Appreciate the help getting onboarding unblocked.
Liz Chen: Welcome aboard again — see you at 1:30pm.
Samira Patel: See you!
